incident-bot: Pager: USW cluster gen-queue high latency detected (p1). Error rate spiked ~10:02 UTC. Paging oncall.

alex (oncall): I'm on it, joining bridge. Kicking off quick triage.

maria (sre): Seen similar signal earlier in staging, might be KV cache invalidation. Checking metrics now.

alex (oncall): Repro: streaming completions hang ~200-400ms extra for many requests. CPU stable, GPU queue depth up.

sre-ops: Quick mitigation — re-route a subset of traffic to fallback model group (gen-v1-fallback) while we investigate. Need comms draft for statuspage.

emily (commops): Drafting initial status update. Suggest we call out "partial degradation of streaming generation in US-West; some requests seeing increased latency" and include mitigation routing.

emily (commops): ```INITIAL UPDATE (DRAFT): We are investigating increased latency affecting streaming generation for some US-West customers. We have routed traffic to a fallback model group to reduce impact. Engineers are actively diagnosing root cause. No data loss is expected. Next update in 30 minutes or sooner.```

alex (oncall): Looks accurate. Add: "Customers may see transient increased token latency and occasional streaming stalls".

emily (commops): Updated draft: ```We are investigating increased latency affecting streaming generation for some US-West customers. We have routed traffic to a fallback model group to reduce impact. Customers may see transient increased token latency and occasional streaming stalls. Engineers are actively diagnosing root cause. No data loss is expected. Next update in 30 minutes or sooner.```

legal: Confirmed language OK, no regulatory flags.

emily (commops): @statuspage-bot please hold for publish approval once I confirm an ETA. Priority: initial publish now to reduce inbound tickets.

statuspage-bot: Ready to publish initial update. 

alex (oncall): Publish now. Also note: rollback of recent config push to routing agent is in progress (pushed 10:06 UTC).

statuspage-bot: Initial status page update published. ID: SP-UST-2026-04-15-01.

maria (sre): Investigation: KV cache compaction job triggered unexpectedly and caused degraded throughput on serving nodes. We are stopping the compaction and validating node health.

emily (commops): Preparing follow-up update. Draft below.

emily (commops): ```FOLLOW-UP (DRAFT): Update: We routed a portion of traffic to a fallback model group and rolled back a recent routing config change. We identified an unexpected KV cache compaction job that increased serving latency; that job has been stopped. We are validating system health and monitoring for improvements. We will post another update in 15 minutes or sooner. Impact: increased generation latency and occasional stream stalls in US-West.```

alex (oncall): LGTM. Add ETA: "expected recovery within 20-40 minutes as nodes heal" if health checks pass.

emily (commops): Final follow-up text: ```Update: We routed a portion of traffic to a fallback model group and rolled back a recent routing config change. We identified and stopped an unexpected KV cache compaction job that increased serving latency; node health checks are running. Expected recovery within 20-40 minutes if checks pass. Impact: increased generation latency and occasional stream stalls in US-West.```

statuspage-bot: Follow-up update published.

maria (sre): Health checks green on 70% of affected nodes, queue depth decreasing. Continuing validation.

emily (commops): Scheduling resolved notice draft once we see sustained normal metrics for 10 minutes. Draft resolve text: ```Resolved: The KV cache compaction job was stopped and routing config was rolled back. Service has returned to normal for affected customers in US-West. If you continue to experience issues, please contact support.```

alex (oncall): Confirming sustained normal metrics at 10:45 UTC for 12 minutes. Ready to publish resolved.

emily (commops): Legal OK. Publishing resolved now.

statuspage-bot: Resolved notice published. Incident closed in status page (SP-UST-2026-04-15-01).

emily (commops): Postmortem items: (1) add guard on compaction job scheduling, (2) add synthetic streaming check for US-West, (3) review routing config rollback automation. I'll open ticket and own comms follow-up. :memo:

alex (oncall): Thanks team. Assigning follow-ups to eng backlog.
